name: Datadog
description: Datadog is an AI-powered observability and security platform that lets teams see inside any stack, any app, at any scale, unifying infrastructure monitoring, APM, logs, security, and user-experience monitoring.
best_for: Organizations managing complex, distributed cloud systems who need unified monitoring across infrastructure, applications, logs, and security teams.
features: Infrastructure monitoring across servers, containers, Kubernetes, and serverless
Application Performance Monitoring (APM) and code profiling
Bits AI Agents that chat, investigate, and help remediate issues
Network monitoring for analyzing traffic across cloud environments
Real User Monitoring for frontend and user-journey performance
Synthetic monitoring for proactively testing critical features
Cloud security monitoring unified with observability data

alternatives.name: Sentry
alternatives.description: An error monitoring and observability platform that tracks errors and performance issues across languages and frameworks.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want error tracking and debugging tightly focused on application code.

alternatives.name: Snyk
alternatives.description: A developer security platform for finding and fixing vulnerabilities in code, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure as code.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want security scanning integrated into their monitoring and development workflow.

pricing.starting_price: $15 per infrastructure host/month when billed annually (Infrastructure Pro)

tiers.name: Infrastructure Pro
tiers.notes: The same public price list shows $18 month-to-month or on-demand. This is one Datadog product, not an all-platform bundle.

tiers.name: Infrastructure Enterprise
tiers.notes: The public price list shows $27 month-to-month or on-demand.

tiers.name: APM
tiers.notes: APM is separately metered; ingested and indexed spans can add separate usage charges.

pros: Publishes a detailed list of billing units and annual, month-to-month, and on-demand prices for many products
Offers both a high-watermark host plan and a hybrid monthly/hourly plan for different infrastructure patterns
Combines infrastructure, application, logs, security, digital-experience, and software-delivery monitoring in one product family
cons: There is no single platform price: infrastructure hosts, APM hosts, logs, spans, custom metrics, containers, and other products use separate billing units
On the high-watermark plan, host charges use the maximum of the lower 99% of hourly readings rather than a simple monthly average
Usage above a hybrid-plan commitment and separately metered ingestion or indexing can increase the bill beyond the headline host price

faq.question: How much does Datadog Infrastructure Monitoring cost?
faq.answer: Datadog’s public list prices Infrastructure Pro at $15 per infrastructure host/month when billed annually and $18 month-to-month or on-demand. Infrastructure Enterprise is listed at $23 annually or $27 month-to-month/on-demand.

faq.question: Does the Datadog host price include APM and logs?
faq.answer: No. Datadog lists APM, log ingestion/indexing, custom metrics, containers, and many other capabilities as separate billing units. A buyer should model the products and retained data the deployment will actually use.

faq.question: How does Datadog count hosts?
faq.answer: Its billing documentation describes a high-watermark plan based on the maximum of the lower 99% of hourly host readings, and a hybrid plan that combines a monthly commitment with hourly overage charges.
